name: io.github.LocalProDev/local-services
title: LocalPro — Verified US Local Service Provider Data
description: Verified US local service provider data across 9 trade categories: water damage restoration, foundation repair, crawl space repair, mold/asbestos remediation, septic services, basement waterproofing, laundry services, floor coating, radon mitigation. ~7,000 providers with Google ratings, opening hours, recent reviews, AI summaries, and contact links.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key for premium fields (certifications, full pricing). All search and list tools work without a key.
